country.note: Uppercase ISO code from a fixed list, or ALL; a candidate for the shared country option.

search_lang.note: Language code from a fixed list; a candidate for the shared locale option.

freshness.note: pd | pw | pm | py, or a YYYY-MM-DDtoYYYY-MM-DD range.

text_decorations.note: Boolean; highlight markup is stripped from results either way.

result_filter.note: Comma-separated result types; leaving out web leaves the results empty.

goggles.note: A Goggle URL or inline definition that re-ranks results.

extra_snippets.note: Boolean; the extra snippets fill SearchResult.content when returned.

summary.note: Boolean; the summarizer key stays in raw.

enable_rich_callback.note: Boolean; the rich callback key stays in raw.

operators.note: Boolean; whether search operators in q are applied.

x-loc-lat.note: A request header; provider_options sets query parameters only.

x-loc-long.note: A request header; provider_options sets query parameters only.

x-loc-timezone.note: A request header; provider_options sets query parameters only.

x-loc-city.note: A request header; provider_options sets query parameters only.

x-loc-state.note: A request header; provider_options sets query parameters only.

x-loc-state-name.note: A request header; provider_options sets query parameters only.

x-loc-country.note: A request header; provider_options sets query parameters only.

x-loc-postal-code.note: A request header; provider_options sets query parameters only.
